name: CNPS Marin Chapter Micro Grants

funder.name: California Native Plant Society, Marin Chapter

summary: Small gap-filling grants from the Marin chapter of the California Native Plant Society for native plant projects. Individuals and organisations apply with a one-page letter.

eligibility.rule: Project is not an ongoing, repeating or annually occurring event or expense unless funds support a new expansion
Any garden or habitat requesting funding is publicly accessible
Applicant is not a current CNPS Marin Chapter board member or committee chair
Project is entirely or substantially completed in 2026

documents: Supporting organization confirmation note, if applying individually for a project benefiting an entity

calls.label: Annual December round
calls.recurring: Applications are due in December each year; recipients are announced in February.

status.quote: Deadline for applying is in December each year.

recurring.quote: Deadline for applying is in December each year.

applicant_types.quote: The Marin chapter is pleased to offer individuals and organizations limited funding through our Micro Grant program, intended to close funding gaps and assist with projects that advance our mission.

access.quote: The application process requires a one-page letter.

window.quote: Deadline for applying is in December each year.

effort.quote: Submissions should be emailed to marincnpsgrants@gmail.com by Dec. 15, 2025.

eligibility.quote: The project must be in Marin county.
The project must not be an ongoing, repeating or annually occurring event or expense unless the funds will support a new expansion of an existing program.
Gardens and habitats requesting funding must be publicly accessible.
Current board members and committee chairs of the CNPS Marin Chapter are not eligible to apply.
Projects need to be entirely or substantially completed in 2026.

after_award.quote: Grant recipients will be asked to report on their completed project to Marin CNPS, in a form to be determined with each recipient.

documents.quote: A single page letter explaining the project/equipment/training/event you desire funding for.

If you are applying as an individual working on a project that will benefit a local government, nonprofit, school or other entity, please submit a short note from the organization confirming that this project is supported by their organization.
